h1: Wonderlic Test Practice & Quiz — Instant Answers & Explanations
subhead: Take a free practice quiz or point your phone at any Wonderlic-style question for the answer plus a fast explanation of the logic — build speed for the real 12-minute test.
metaTitle: Wonderlic Test Practice & Quiz: Instant Answers | Cambo
metaDescription: Free Wonderlic Personnel Test quiz and practice questions with instant, explained answers. Math, verbal, and logic — build speed for the real 12-minute test.
whyItWorks: The Wonderlic gives you 50 questions in 12 minutes — even less time per question than the CCAT — so recognizing the pattern instantly matters more than raw difficulty. Cambo answers a practice question right away so you can see the shortcut, not just the final number.

sampleQuestions.q: Look at the row of numbers: 8 4 2 1 0.5. What number should come next?
sampleQuestions.a: 0.25 — each number is half of the one before it.

sampleQuestions.q: Paper sells for 21 cents per pad. What will 4 pads cost?
If 3 workers can build a wall in 12 hours, how long would it take 6 workers, assuming the same rate per worker?
sampleQuestions.a: 6 hours — doubling the number of workers halves the time needed, assuming a constant rate per worker.

sampleQuestions.q: Which word is most nearly opposite of 'reluctant'?
sampleQuestions.a: Eager — reluctant means unwilling or hesitant, so its opposite describes being willing and enthusiastic.

sampleQuestions.q: A jacket originally priced at $60 is on sale for 30% off. What is the sale price?
In the sequence 2, 5, 11, 23, what is the next number?
sampleQuestions.a: 47 — each number is roughly double the previous one plus one (2×2+1=5, 5×2+1=11, 11×2+1=23, 23×2+1=47).

faqs.a: A 12-minute, 50-question cognitive ability test used by employers (and historically the NFL) to quickly assess problem-solving speed across math, verbal, and logic questions.
Scores range from 0-50, with 20 often cited as roughly average. What counts as 'good' depends heavily on the role and employer's own benchmark.

faqs.q: How is the Wonderlic different from the CCAT?
faqs.a: Both are short cognitive aptitude tests, but the Wonderlic gives you even less time per question (about 15 seconds average vs. 18 for the CCAT) and is published by a different company.
No. Cambo is an independent study tool and isn't produced, endorsed, or affiliated with Wonderlic.
It depends on the employer administering it — policies vary, so check directly with the company or program you're applying to.

faqs.q: What kinds of questions are on the Wonderlic?
faqs.a: A mix of math word problems, verbal analogies and vocabulary, logical reasoning, and pattern recognition, all under significant time pressure.
